chapter-b1-1-infinitiv-mit-zu-data.js.title: Infinitiv mit zu
chapter-b1-1-infinitiv-mit-zu-data.js.intro: Renke is planning to spend the summer camping and lazing around outdoors, and Timo wants to know why — every plan expressed with zu + Infinitiv: Ich plane, zu campen. Ich habe vor, mich zu entspannen.

chapter-b1-10-passiv-praesens-data.js.title: Passiv (Präsens)
chapter-b1-10-passiv-praesens-data.js.scene: Ein Besuch im Museum und beim Friseur
chapter-b1-10-passiv-praesens-data.js.intro: At the hairdresser\'s, Timo asks what\'s being done to his hair today, and Frau Bruns answers step by step — washed, then cut, coloured only on request. The present passive puts the process front and centre, not who\'s doing it.

chapter-b1-11-relativsaetze-dativ-data.j.title: Relativsätze im Dativ
chapter-b1-11-relativsaetze-dativ-data.j.intro: A stormy forecast has Marret and Timo comparing who they trust — the weather forecast, the dark clouds, the storm neither of them quite believes — every description built on a Dativ relative clause: der Mann, dem ich vertraue; die Prognose, der ich g

chapter-b1-12-adjektivdeklination-wieder.title: Adjektivdeklination (Wiederholung & Vertiefung)
chapter-b1-12-adjektivdeklination-wieder.scene: Ein Café am Nachmittag — Anna zeigt Rohan ihre Bewerbung
chapter-b1-12-adjektivdeklination-wieder.intro: Antje has written a new job application — cover letter, CV, a photo Timo calls compelling — and every document needs one more certificate, one more adjective ending, weak, mixed or strong, all doing the same job: showing gender, number and case exact

chapter-b1-13-goethe-mini-2-data.js.title: Goethe Mini 2
chapter-b1-13-goethe-mini-2-data.js.intro: Timo and Grit spend a Saturday running errands — an apartment viewing with high extra costs, an excited decision to call the landlord today — recycling obwohl, wegen, and a polite Konjunktiv II offer all at once.

chapter-b1-14-komparativ-superlativ-vor-.title: Komparativ & Superlativ vor Nomen
chapter-b1-14-komparativ-superlativ-vor-.scene: Im Café — Wiebke und Timo vergleichen Wohnungen und Städte
chapter-b1-14-komparativ-superlativ-vor-.intro: Wiebke and Timo compare neighbourhoods — a bigger park here, a better traffic situation there, the highest quality of life somewhere else — every comparison landing directly in front of a noun, with the declension ending riding along: der schnellere

chapter-b1-15-n-deklination-data.js.title: N-Deklination
chapter-b1-15-n-deklination-data.js.intro: Silje and Timo run through the people they know — a lawyer, a judge, a chemist, maybe a reporter — every one of them an N-Deklination noun that quietly grows an -n or -en in every case but the first.

chapter-b1-16-futur1-data.js.title: Futur I
chapter-b1-16-futur1-data.js.scene: Silvesterabend — Emke und Timo planen das neue Jahr
chapter-b1-16-futur1-data.js.intro: On Silvesterabend, Emke and Timo plan their year ahead — a smart home, blinds and lights controlled from a phone, a budget kept modest — using Futur I for plans, predictions, promises and assumptions about what\'s coming.

chapter-b1-17-nebensatz-damit-um-zu-data.title: Nebensätze mit damit & um ... zu
chapter-b1-17-nebensatz-damit-um-zu-data.scene: Samstagvormittag — Antke und Timo sortieren den Müll
chapter-b1-17-nebensatz-damit-um-zu-data.intro: Antke returns bottles for the deposit while Timo sorts the trash so the environment gets cleaner — every action justified with a purpose clause, some with um…zu, some with damit, depending on who\'s doing what.

chapter-b1-18-relativsaetze-mit-praeposi.title: Relativsätze mit Präpositionen
chapter-b1-18-relativsaetze-mit-praeposi.intro: A walk through the city gives Marlen and Timo landmarks, monuments, and narrow alleys to describe — every one needing a relative clause where the preposition stays glued to the pronoun: der Turm, mit dem wir beginnen; die Gasse, in der wir stehen.

chapter-b1-19-goethe-halbzeit-test-data..title: Goethe Halbzeit-Test
chapter-b1-19-goethe-halbzeit-test-data..scene: Ein langer Samstag in der Stadt
chapter-b1-19-goethe-halbzeit-test-data..intro: A long Saturday: Uta wants to apply for an apartment fast because the price is good, and Timo — despite his nerves — offers her honest feedback on the application letter, recycling everything from the first half of B1 in one continuous story.

chapter-b1-2-nebensaetze-weil-da-obwohl-.title: Nebensätze: weil / da & obwohl
chapter-b1-2-nebensaetze-weil-da-obwohl-.intro: Frauke has lost her appetite for camping — it\'s too cold outside — while Timo wants to go to the beach anyway. Every reason and every unexpected contrast reaches for weil, da, or obwohl, all sending the verb to the very end.

chapter-b1-20-plusquamperfekt-data.js.title: Plusquamperfekt
chapter-b1-20-plusquamperfekt-data.js.intro: Wenke and Timo catch up on old friends they lost touch with — she had already moved before they stopped seeing each other, he had finished his studies before he moved away too — every memory built on two layers of the past: what had already happened,

chapter-b1-21-temporale-nebensaetze-data.title: Temporale Nebensätze
chapter-b1-21-temporale-nebensaetze-data.intro: Runa and Timo work through a small disagreement about noise and headphones — since she moved in, before he speaks, while she sleeps — using all five ways German answers "when?": als, wenn, bevor, nachdem, während.

chapter-b1-22-brauchen-zu-infinitiv-data.title: brauchen + zu + Infinitiv
chapter-b1-22-brauchen-zu-infinitiv-data.intro: Katrin sets up online banking while Timo reassures her it\'s easier than she thinks — she doesn\'t need to visit the bank, doesn\'t need to check her balance daily. müssen says what you have to do; brauchen nicht … zu says what you don\'t.

chapter-b1-23-reflexivpronomen-akkusativ.title: Reflexivpronomen: Akkusativ & Dativ
chapter-b1-23-reflexivpronomen-akkusativ.intro: Timo is recovering in hospital after a small accident, and Frauke helps him through his morning routine — brushing his teeth, getting his medication, feeding himself — every reflexive verb revealing whether it needs mich/dich or mir/dir.

chapter-b1-24-zweiteilige-konnektoren-da.title: Zweiteilige Konnektoren
chapter-b1-24-zweiteilige-konnektoren-da.intro: Nike and Timo compare music tastes and plan a concert trip — she likes both jazz and metal, he likes neither; she listens to not only music but also podcasts — every opinion built on a two-part connector.

chapter-b1-25-stellung-von-nicht-data.js.title: Stellung von „nicht" im Satz
chapter-b1-25-stellung-von-nicht-data.js.intro: Sinje and Timo pass an honesty-box newspaper stand — she won\'t take the change, because that isn\'t right, and won\'t keep the wallet either — a small moral test of exactly what "nicht" is negating each time.

chapter-b1-26-adjektiv-ohne-artikel-data.title: Adjektivdeklination ohne Artikel
chapter-b1-26-adjektiv-ohne-artikel-data.intro: Yara needs talented actors and colourful costumes for the school play, and Timo offers musical friends from choir and old costumes from home — every noun phrase here has no article at all, so the adjective alone must carry gender, case and number.

chapter-b1-27-goethe-mini-3-data.js.title: Goethe Mini 3
chapter-b1-27-goethe-mini-3-data.js.intro: Marte and Timo compare a demanding week — a job interview that exhausted her, a delayed connection, a doctor\'s visit — recycling Plusquamperfekt, temporal clauses, and two-part connectors from every B1 chapter so far.

chapter-b1-28-passiv-praesens-praeteritu.title: Passiv: Präsens, Präteritum & Perfekt
chapter-b1-28-passiv-praesens-praeteritu.intro: At an environmental-action fair, Insa and Timo read reports on recycling improvements, planted trees, and monitored drinking water — the same action phrased in three tenses: wird verbessert, wurde verbessert, ist verbessert worden.

chapter-b1-29-passiv-modalverben-data.js.title: Passiv mit Modalverben
chapter-b1-29-passiv-modalverben-data.js.intro: A lecture on the European Union has Solveig and Timo working through contracts that must be signed, decisions that must be made, member states that must be informed — the passive combined with every modal verb, werden always last.

chapter-b1-3-konjunktiv2-hoefliche-bitte.title: Konjunktiv II: Höfliche Bitten
chapter-b1-3-konjunktiv2-hoefliche-bitte.scene: Ein langer Samstag in der Stadt
chapter-b1-3-konjunktiv2-hoefliche-bitte.intro: Timo\'s phone has broken, and Frau Lorenzen at the shop helps him fix it — every request softened into a polite Konjunktiv II: Könnten Sie mir helfen? Würden Sie es bitte anschließen?

chapter-b1-30-artikelwoerter-als-pronome.title: Artikelwörter als Pronomen
chapter-b1-30-artikelwoerter-als-pronome.scene: Beim Bäcker und bei der Bürgerversammlung
chapter-b1-30-artikelwoerter-als-pronome.intro: Frauke and Timo run errands at the bakery and sign up to help at a neighbourhood event — every repeated noun replaced by an article word standing in for it: Welches meinst du? Das von letztem Jahr. Welche schmecken am besten? Die mit Schokolade.

chapter-b1-31-adjektive-als-nomen-data.j.title: Adjektive als Nomen
chapter-b1-31-adjektive-als-nomen-data.j.intro: Meike and Timo watch election coverage and talk about their community — every adjective turning into a person: der Abgeordnete speaks about justice, die Deutsche fights for free speech, der Fremde runs for parliament.

chapter-b1-32-relativsaetze-was-wo-data..title: Relativsätze mit was & wo
chapter-b1-32-relativsaetze-was-wo-data..intro: Renke and Timo wander through a street-art district, impressed by everything they see and the places they found it — was refers back to a whole idea, wo to a place: alles, was mir gefällt; die Wand, wo das Kunstwerk hängt.

chapter-b1-33-je-desto-umso-data.js.title: je … desto / umso
chapter-b1-33-je-desto-umso-data.js.intro: Over lunch, Britta and Timo debate globalization — the more we buy, the more trash accumulates; the cheaper a product, the more people buy it — every argument a proportional comparison with je…desto or umso.

chapter-b1-34-partizipien-als-adjektive-.title: Partizipien als Adjektive
chapter-b1-34-partizipien-als-adjektive-.intro: Kirsten and Timo stumble into a mix-up at an art-supermarket auction — a found mirror, a laughing seller, a damaged pot nobody can explain — every object described with a participle adjective: der gefundene Spiegel, der beschädigte Topf.

chapter-b1-35-goethe-zertifikat-b1-final.title: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Final
chapter-b1-35-goethe-zertifikat-b1-final.scene: Ein letzter Tag vor der Prüfung
chapter-b1-35-goethe-zertifikat-b1-final.intro: Silke and Timo spend one last day together — an apartment viewing, a hospital visit, a job interview, a delayed train — recycling every major B1 structure in one continuous story before the real exam.

chapter-b1-4-folgen-deshalb-so-dass-data.title: Folgen: deshalb & so … dass
chapter-b1-4-folgen-deshalb-so-dass-data.intro: Franzi wants to return a broken charging cable, and Timo checks the receipt — the cable is so broken it won\'t charge, and she\'s so surprised it broke this fast. Every result gets a deshalb, every extreme a so … dass.

chapter-b1-5-genitiv-wegen-trotz-waehren.title: Genitiv & Präpositionen mit Genitiv
chapter-b1-5-genitiv-wegen-trotz-waehren.intro: Timo explains his diet to Kerstin — no meat because of it, cheese despite it, vegan cooking during the week for his fitness — every reason, contrast, and stretch of time carried by a Genitiv preposition: wegen, trotz, während.

chapter-b1-6-goethe-mini-1-data.js.title: Goethe Mini 1
chapter-b1-6-goethe-mini-1-data.js.scene: Der Abend vor der Probeprüfung — Sprachschule Berlin
chapter-b1-6-goethe-mini-1-data.js.intro: The evening before the mock exam, Meike is nervous and Timo reassures her — since she\'s practised so much, she\'ll surely succeed — recycling zu + Infinitiv, weil/da/obwohl, polite requests, and the Genitiv all at once.

chapter-b1-7-praeteritum-data.js.title: Präteritum
chapter-b1-7-praeteritum-data.js.intro: Almut tells Timo about the summer she worked at a mountain hut — calm, beautiful, arriving in June — and every memory reaches for the Präteritum, the tense of stories and biographies.

chapter-b1-8-zeitangaben-dativ-genitiv-d.title: Zeitangaben: Dativ & Genitiv
chapter-b1-8-zeitangaben-dativ-genitiv-d.intro: At the travel agency, Timo books a winter holiday and Frau Petersen answers with deadlines and travel times — a week for confirmation, a day\'s journey by train — mixing everyday Dativ time phrases with the more literary Genitiv ones.

chapter-b1-9-goethe-mini-2-data.js.title: Goethe Mini 2
chapter-b1-9-goethe-mini-2-data.js.intro: Nele has an interview tomorrow with an entrepreneur, and Timo helps her prepare — her outfit, her posture, whether she comes across as too stiff — recycling Präteritum and Zeitangaben across the whole conversation.
